title: NewRelic Crash Reporting is buggy and causes frequent app restarts
body:
Commit c6c289d changed the crash reporting from Fabric to NewRelic. 

Unfortunately, this causes frequent app restarts on various devices and Android versions (see #1629 for instance), increases battery consumption and produces the following error in the log:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1370732/106398811-46368100-6415-11eb-9b62-2d35a277986d.png)

Logcat shows restart of the whole app and tries to recreate the database tables frequently. Rarely the following is logged:

```
2021-01-31 00:40:33.841 28471-28471/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip I/FirebaseInitProvider: FirebaseApp initialization successful
2021-01-31 00:40:35.166 28471-28471/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip E/xdrip.java: java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method 'void com.newrelic.agent.android.harvest.HarvestTimer.setPeriod(long)' on a null object reference
2021-01-31 00:40:37.206 28471-28471/com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip E/SQLiteLog: (1) duplicate column name: dg_mgdl
```

comments.body: Did you see this logcat message on a release version of xDrip or on a private development version?

The logcat output is from the most recent debug build but the screenshot from nightly release. Hence, the underlying problem persists in both versions. At LineageOS 17.1 I even get a message appearing about every minute that xDrip is not responding, wait or close the app. If I disable "Automatic Crash Reporting", messages disappear but the app still restarts frequently. I'm still investigating this.
We have to check whether ebba2d8 fixes this problem.

I am told this should not happen unless the app is being installed frequently.
We can reopen if needed.
